newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat follows soybeans to higher close.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat follows soybeans to higher close.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled higher on spillover support from the limit-up rally in CBOT soybeans, traders said.
May, July and August soybeans surged to close at their 30-cent upper trading limit on heavy fund buying, pit sources in Chicago said.

Traders said the surge in soybeans influenced the spring wheat market more than other U.S. wheat markets because of ideas that the price of soybeans will play an important role in helping farmers in the northern U.S. Plains determine what to plant.
Traditional spring wheat growers have said they are seriously considering planting beans in lieu of wheat because the price of soybeans is relatively more attractive.
This perceived link in prices ushered in some fund buying in MGE spring wheat at the midsession, one trader said.
MGE spring wheat ended 3-1/2 to seven cents per bushel higher, with March up 3-1/2 cents at $4.28 a bushel. New crop September was the biggest gainer, closing up seven cents at $3.79-3/4.
MGE barley futures settled four to five cents per cwt lower, with March down five cents at $6.75 per cwt.
